subject: [VOTE] Release Apache Airflow 2.10.4 from 2.10.4-rc1
body:
To: dev@airflow.apache.org
Subject: [VOTE] Release Apache Airflow 2.10.4 from 2.10.4-rc1

Hi all,

I propose we release the following artifacts as Apache Airflow 2.10.4.

The release artifacts, signatures, and checksums are available at:
  https://dist.apache.org/repos/dist/dev/airflow/2.10.4-rc1/

The release tag to be voted upon:
  https://github.com/apache/airflow/releases/tag/2.10.4-rc1

The changelog for this release:
  https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/2.10.4-rc1/CHANGELOG.md

Keys to verify artifact signatures:
  https://dist.apache.org/repos/dist/release/airflow/KEYS

How to verify this candidate before voting
------------------------------------------
Reproducibility record (from the planning issue):
  source commit:     a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f9012345678
  SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH: 1758400000
  sha512:            77ab…10 (apache_airflow-2.10.4.tar.gz)

Agentic path (any agent with the Magpie release skills, read-only):
  /magpie-release-management:verify-rc 2.10.4-rc1
  It checks the signature against KEYS, the checksum, licence headers
  (RAT), LICENSE/NOTICE, prohibited binaries, dangling links, version
  strings, rebuilds the source artefact from the tag to confirm it is
  byte-identical to what is staged, and rebuilds and compares every
  convenience artefact.

Manual path (the same checks, longhand):
  https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/2.10.4-rc1/docs/verifying-a-release-candidate.md
  Reproducibility background: https://github.com/apache/magpie/blob/main/docs/release-management/reproducibility.md

A binding +1 means you downloaded the artefact, verified it, and built
and tested it on your own hardware; the tools above are an aid, not a
substitute (https://www.apache.org/legal/release-policy.html#release-approval).

Please vote to release:
  [ ] +1  Release Apache Airflow 2.10.4
  [ ] +0
  [ ] -1  Do not release (please comment with specific reasons)

This vote is open for at least 48 hours.

[EXPEDITED: Critical security fix for CVE-2026-12345; abbreviated window approved by PMC chair. ASF policy requires this deviation to be noted in the project's next board report.]

Thanks,
<RM name>
